summary: St. Joe National Forest lookout: crow's nest in 1922, 60-foot tower in 1929, gone by 1953. A later page note found cabin ruins and tie-downs but not the crow's nest or footings.

facts.design: 60-foot pole tower with 7x7 cab and log cabin living quarters
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1953 per two sources; Forest Lookouts says abandoned. Visitors found cabin ruins and tie-downs but could not find the crow's nest or the tower footings.

access.note: Listed as hike-in; no source we read states access rules.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say the tower was destroyed in 1953; Forest Lookouts says abandoned in 1953. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Brief height 18.3 m (60 ft), county and build year (1929) confirmed. The current-condition account is a single page note dated August 19, 2025, so treat it as a snapshot. A reader comment on the same page about a 1944 staffing is left out as unverified. The page's photos are credited to the Bert Russel Collection, with no image URLs or license given, so none were added.
